name: Parker Burgess
summary: Senior software engineer and former team lead with 14+ years building data-heavy products in C#/.NET, SQL Server, and Azure. Spent a decade at B3 Insight, an oil & gas water-data company, growing with it from founding-stage startup to established platform — from building the first product to setting technical direction for a 5-person team. Strongest where data quality, system design, and business priorities meet.

skills.items: .NET, ASP.NET, Blazor, Next.js/React, REST APIs, Aurelia
SQL Server, Azure SQL, Database Design, Performance Tuning, ETL
Team Leadership & Mentoring, Hiring, Requirements, Project & Product Management

bullets: Planned two-year travel sabbatical.
Built a family of Next.js/TypeScript web apps backed by Azure SQL, including a standalone authentication service shared across the apps.

experience.description: Water and subsurface data platform for the oil & gas industry; joined at founding stage.

roles.title: Lead Software Engineer – Team Lead
bullets: Promoted to lead a team of 5 developers, running day-to-day engineering: stand-ups, code reviews, ongoing team education, mentoring of junior developers, and management of infrastructure and tech debt.
Owned most technical decisions company-wide and shaped the rest, spanning infrastructure and third-party vendors including Azure, SOC 2 contractors, and data providers.
Headed the SOC 2 research and cost-benefit evaluation, which concluded certification wasn’t worth pursuing, and co-led a company-wide security overhaul.
Partnered with product leadership on project and product prioritization, weighing company-wide value, task scale, and resource availability to expand or scale back projects.
Guided design and architecture decisions for the customer-facing product alongside its primary developer, and drove the advanced map and data-filtering project.
Retained full ownership of the internal data platform (all 3 apps and 9 pipelines) alongside lead responsibilities.

roles.title: Senior Software Engineer – Internal App Lead
bullets: Designed, built, and owned B3’s internal data platform: three Blazor/SQL Server applications (Data Entry, Data Acceptance, Data Management), from initial requirements through data structures, development, deployment, and maintenance — as sole developer for the first two years.
Built 9 stream-specific data pipelines covering Texas wells, Texas skim pits, New Mexico wells, and company ownership data, each with its own tables, business rules, automated tests, and data flow.

Created a two-stage quality gate: double entry with automated comparison for manually processed Texas Railroad Commission H-1/H-1A/W-14 filings and review of third-party scraped skim-pit data, followed by automated test suites that routed issues into a correction workflow before data reached production.
Developed data-management tools to standardize company names, construct ownership histories, assign owners to newly discovered wells, and apply corrections surfaced by ongoing research.
Designed full change history from raw to production, so any record could be reverted to its raw state or reprocessed under new business rules.

Managed 2 data-entry specialists and worked daily with 2 analysts, adapting rules and workflows as business needs changed; in the final year, trained and mentored a junior and a mid-level developer in the codebase.
Led 2 company-name and ownership-history projects — one using Texas skim-oil records, one using public company records — that improved name quality across production data.

roles.title: Software Engineer – Business Support
bullets: Extended the core product (JavaScript front end, REST API, SQL Server) with new features, process improvements, and bug fixes.
Analyzed raw data and business rules to build software for internal data-processing and data-quality workflows.

roles.title: Software Engineer – Product and Research
bullets: Explored several early-stage business ideas during the startup phase, working with subject-matter experts to gather, organize, and analyze data.
Collaborated with the founding team to build the first version of the company’s main product, contributing to design and feature development.
Re-platformed the main product from ASP.NET to JavaScript/Aurelia as it matured.

roles.title: Software Developer
bullets: Resolved bugs in the company’s main software product and supported customers directly by phone.

roles.title: Junior Software Developer
bullets: Built stored procedures, functions, triggers, and views to support application development.
Wrote complex SQL queries to extract, analyze, and transform data across multiple databases.
Wrote scripts to gather data from external sources.
